text_block_list.text:
With the arrival of the Satsuki Sho, Yaeno 
Muteki found herself reminiscing about 
past days.

When driven by passion, a young Yaeno 
Muteki would try to solve things with 
force. However, that tendency was 
something she struggled to suppress.

Guided patiently by her grandfather's 
teachings and supported closely by her 
grandmother, she was able to reach where 
she is today.

With gratitude toward her grandparents in 
her heart, Yaeno Muteki vowed to win the 
Satsuki Sho as proof of her growth.

Sakura Chiyono O is also running in the 
Satsuki Sho. The very first battle of the 
Classic Triple Crown begins now!
